title: User and Cart Service Layer

interfaces.name: UserService
methods: registerUser(userName: String, mobileNo: Long, emailId: String, address: String, pinCode: int, password: String): String

interfaces.name: CartService
methods: addProductToCart(userId: String, prodId: String, prodQty: int): String
updateProductToCart(userId: String, prodId: String, prodQty: int): String

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
methods: registerUser(userName: String, mobileNo: Long, emailId: String, address: String, pinCode: int, password: String): String

classes.name: CartServiceImpl
methods: addProductToCart(userId: String, prodId: String, prodQty: int): String
updateProductToCart(userId: String, prodId: String, prodQty: int): String

key_relationships: UserServiceImpl depends_on IUserConstants (table name constant TABLE_USER)
CartServiceImpl uses CartBean (read from DB, return list)
CartServiceImpl instantiates DemandServiceImpl (addProduct for out-of-stock demand tracking)
interaction_flow: registerUser(UserBean) → isRegistered(email) → DBUtil.provideConnection() → INSERT user → MailMessage.registrationSuccess()
isValidCredential(email, password) → DBUtil.provideConnection() → SELECT user WHERE email AND password → returns 'valid' or error
getUserDetails(email, password) → SELECT user → populates and returns UserBean
addProductToCart(userId, prodId, qty) → SELECT usercart → if exists: ProductServiceImpl.getProductDetails(prodId) → check availableQty → updateProductToCart() OR DemandServiceImpl.addProduct()
updateProductToCart(userId, prodId, qty) → SELECT usercart → if exists+qty>0: UPDATE; if qty==0: DELETE; if not exists: INSERT
removeProductFromCart(userId, prodId) → SELECT usercart → decrement qty → if qty>0: UPDATE; if qty<=0: DELETE
removeAProduct(userId, prodId) → DELETE from usercart directly
important_notes: CartServiceImpl has one non-interface method: getProductCount(userId, prodId): int — queries SUM(quantity) per product per user
addProductToCart checks stock via ProductServiceImpl instantiation (tight coupling — no injection)
Out-of-stock surplus demand is tracked via DemandServiceImpl instantiation inside CartServiceImpl
UserServiceImpl.registerUser(UserBean) calls isRegistered() to prevent duplicate email registration before INSERT
MailMessage.registrationSuccess() called only on successful INSERT (k > 0)
All DB operations use DBUtil.provideConnection() / DBUtil.closeConnection() — no connection pool abstraction visible
registerUser(UserBean) has a bug: calls DBUtil.closeConnection(ps) twice, never closes Connection
